text: Hinana Ichikawa
Aha... Where is... One Han City?
The four members of noctchill fly to the next stop of their jam-packed tour. When the plane lands, they awake to find themselves in a completely unfamiliar city.
Koito Fukumaru
I-I can't remember this stop at all... Huh?! You guys, look at the schedule...!
The girls gather around Koito Fukumaru and see some strange information on the schedule in her hands.
Tour stop, "One Han City." Rehearsal venue, "Mahjong Soul Shrine." Live venue ...Aha? ...Wait, there's nothing written there!
Mm-hm... Hm? Wait, no, that's not the point... I could've sworn our next stop and rehearsal venue had different names...
Madoka Higuchi
That's not all, I'm afraid.
Madoka Higuchi waves her phone.
It's not working. I can't reach any of the staff.
Huh?! H-How is this happening?

A strange city, a communication blackout, and a mysteriously altered itinerary... With everyone else left speechless, group leader Toru Asakura stands up, points to a spot on the schedule, and makes her decision.
Toru Asakura
Either way, let's just go here.
This is the Mahjong Soul Shrine? But...
Mahjong Soul Shrine
But inside the shrine the clues led them to, they're met by a cat-eared priestess...
They go up to Ichihime and explain why the four of them have shown up at Mahjong Soul Shrine.
Ichihime
Nyaa, I understand. Don't worry, this isn't the first time the Mahjong Soul Shrine has received visitors from another world, nyaa.
Another world?
A talking c-cat...
Kaguyahime
Hehehe, haven't you noticed yet? This is a completely different world from the one you girls came from.
The girls are stunned once again when the girl next to the cat-eared priestess starts to talk.
And a talking r-r-rabbit!

Hmph. You may be from another world, but you're still just ordinary humans--and with the gall to refer to a deity such as myself as a "rabbit." You shall respectfully address me as Kaguyahime-sama. Understood?
U-Understood...
A deity? Aha... It's a relief that deities exist here! Excuse me, but could you please send us back to our world?
Hehehe, I suppose some humans DO have manners! I could send you back easily, it's just...
...Just what?
It's just that you're going to be having a live concert in One Han City, nyaa.
Wh-Why?
Because that's what it says on the schedule, and that's how you'll get back to your own world, nyaa!
Sigh...
Aha--A live? That's wonderful!
But... we're in a different world right now... How are we supposed to pull off a successful show by ourselves in a strange city?
We're always performing up on stage... The stage prep, the backstage work... All of this was previously managed by our staff...
Oh my, so many new faces... Do we have adorable new Jyanshi?
Just as silence falls over everyone, a pink-haired girl pokes her head in from outside.
It's Kana, nyaa! One Han City's pro idol is here!
Kana Fujita
Shh! If my manager hears I snuck out to play mahjong, I'll get in serious trouble! {var:ShakeChar}
Nyaa, nyaa, nyaa... I'm so dizzy... So many dorayaki are spinning around my head, nyaa...{var:ShakeChar}
...Typical reaction for an idol.
After taking the head-spinning Ichihime off Kana Fujita's hands, the girls of noctchill fill Kana in on their story...
Ooh, I see. No problem, just leave it to me!
With a flurry of taps, Kana Fujita confidently sends a form to the girls from her phone.
There you go! Everything will go perfectly fine if we prepare according to the marked items in the form.

Whoa... "How to Select a Venue," "Marketing Guide," "Makeup and Hairstyle Recommendations," "Concert Equipment Preparation"... This sure is a thorough concert planning guide! One Han City's idol r-really knows her stuff!
Haha, it's nothing! I just got some information from the manager with Akane and Mia's help... Hehe... Everything will go perfectly fine if we prepare according to the marked items in the form.
"We?"
Of course! Idols should always help each other. Just think of me as your tour guide on your otherworld adventure!
Thank you so much!
We don't have much time, let's divvy up the tasks and get started.
After a game of rock paper scissors, the girls of noctchill divide into two groups.
Okay!
After waving their goodbyes to Ichihime and Kaguyahime, Kana Fujita and the noctchill members leave the Mahjong Soul Shrine to go make preparations for the live concert.
Hehehe, what pure, simple children they are! Have they not even considered the possibility that they'll fail?
As long as their hearts are in the right place, everything will work out just fine, nyaa!
I shall wait and see then.
Okay, so Hinana and I will contact the venues. Madoka and Koito, you're on concert promotion and equipment.
